title: Lesson 10: RAG Fundamentals: Chunking, Embeddings, Retrieval, and Why RAG Is the First Enterprise Pattern
description: The pattern that grounds LLMs in your own knowledge: what RAG is and where it came from, why you chunk documents instead of feeding them whole, what embeddings actually are, how retrieval ranks chunks, and why RAG became the first pattern enterprises shipped.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: The paper defines the idea precisely: RAG models "combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation." The parametric memory is the model's weights, the knowledge baked in during training.
The term RAG comes from the 2020 paper by Patrick Lewis and colleagues, accepted at NeurIPS 2020.
RAG, retrieval-augmented generation, is the single most deployed pattern in enterprise AI, and it is the first one most teams actually ship.
Lesson 9 ended with a promise: the next building block is the augmented LLM, retrieval that gives agents knowledge beyond their training data.
